description: Source code for MediaEffectsFragment class implementing an Android Fragment that applies various image effects using OpenGL and the Android media.effect API. It manages texture loading, effect initialization, and rendering based on user-selected effects.

classes.name: MediaEffectsFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that applies visual effects to images using OpenGL ES and the Android media.effect API. Handles user interactions, effect selection, texture management, and rendering.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment and sets options menu.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up GLSurfaceView and restores current effect if available.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for effect selection.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection to change effects.

methods.name: onDrawFrame
methods.description: Initializes effect context and textures once, applies selected effect, and renders the result.

methods.name: setCurrentEffect
methods.description: Sets the current effect based on user selection.

methods.name: loadTextures
methods.description: Generates textures, loads bitmap, and uploads to OpenGL textures.

methods.name: initEffect
methods.description: Creates and configures the selected image effect.

methods.name: applyEffect
methods.description: Applies the current effect to the input texture.

methods.name: renderResult
methods.description: Renders the processed or original texture based on effect selection.
